AMEC.why: Chinese etch / deposition tool maker: its plasma etch tools run in volume production of 128-layer-and-above 3D NAND and its tungsten deposition tools serve 3D memory word lines, so NAND capex drives its orders
AMEC.evidence: AMEC 2026 Half-Year Report (08-20-2026): 'In 3D NAND manufacturing, the company's plasma etch tools are used in volume production of 128 layers and above'

players.product: plasma etch tools for 3D NAND and advanced logic (CCP incl. 60:1 ultra-high-aspect-ratio dielectric etch; cryogenic high-aspect-ratio ICP etch) plus tungsten CVD / ALD deposition for 3D NAND word lines

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue about RMB 6.691 billion, up about 34.89% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 2.825 billion (+300.22%), lifted by fair-value and investment gains on equity investments including the sale of part of its Piotech shares; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 1.123 billion (+108.36%).
quarterly_data.figure: revenue RMB 6.691 billion (+34.89% YoY); net profit RMB 2.825 billion (+300.22%); recurring net profit RMB 1.123 billion (+108.36%)

quarterly_data.signal: Company: new shipments of its high-end tools for critical etch steps in advanced logic and memory rose significantly; mid-end critical etch for advanced logic and ultra-high-aspect-ratio etch for advanced memory are in large-scale volume production. Its single-station dielectric etch for critical steps kept growing fast, its 60:1 ultra-high-aspect-ratio dielectric etch tool has become standard equipment in China, and a next-generation ultra-high-aspect-ratio dielectric etch tool is about to enter the market. Its 12-inch high-end etch tools run in an internationally known customer's most advanced lines for several critical steps of 3 nm and below devices.

3D NAND: AMEC plasma etch tools are used in volume production of 128-layer-and-above 3D NAND, and it is developing extremely-high-aspect-ratio etch for memory customers. New PrimoXD-RIE for ultra-high-aspect-ratio etch (new chamber for highly corrosive gases and ultra-low-temperature etch, much less fluorocarbon gas): the Alpha tool completed lab marathon testing and the Beta tool is in smooth customer verification. Its cryogenic high-aspect-ratio ICP etch tool PrimoNanova LUX-Cryo is in stable volume production on a customer's next-generation product line.

Its ICP etch tools (Primo Twin-Star, Primo Nanova, Primo Menova) are in volume production on more than 50 customers' lines across logic, DRAM, 3D NAND, power and MEMS. Its CVD tungsten, high-aspect-ratio tungsten and ALD tungsten tools cover all tungsten applications in memory, passed key memory customers' on-site verification including 3D memory word-line applications, and won repeat volume orders.

R&D investment RMB 2.041 billion in H1 2026 (+36.86%), 30.51% of revenue. Company: its 50-plus products cover over 30% of front-end IC equipment; over the next five years it aims, through in-house development and M&A, to cover more than 60% of the high-end IC equipment market and more than 70% of the advanced packaging equipment market.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D RMB 2.041 billion (30.51% of revenue); target 60%+ of high-end IC equipment and 70%+ of advanced packaging equipment market coverage within five years

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity: the Lingang phase 2 production and R&D base is planned to start construction in H2 2026; the Guangzhou South China headquarters R&D and production base phase 1 topped out in July 2026 with production planned for 2027; the Chengdu R&D and production base phase 1 topped out in August 2026 and is expected to start production in 2027.
